Privacy starts on your device

Your conversations.
Your data.
Your control.

Important conversations deserve a private place. In local mode, your audio and transcription are processed on your own device. You choose what stays and what you share.

Work locally, independently

With local processing selected and setup complete, recording and transcription work on your device without a Pichi account or cloud server. No per-minute cloud transcription charges in local mode.

Keep control of your recordings

Choose whether to keep audio and what to share. Store recordings and text on your device, and decide where to send them.

Share only what you intend

Choose a protected text export to help hide sensitive passages. Review the result, including names and identifying details, before you share it. Cloud processing and uploads are optional.

A few answers

Good to know.
Easy to start.

Does it work without internet?

Yes, for local recording and transcription after you download the required speech files and finish setup. Cloud features need internet.

Do I need an account or pay by the minute?

Local recording and transcription need no Pichi account and incur no cloud transcription charges per minute. Optional cloud services may have their own fees.

Can my phone record calls?

The upcoming iPhone and iPad app is for conversations around you. It does not capture call audio from another app. Use Mac to record online meetings.

What if I want to use a cloud service?

You choose the provider or upload feature and what you send. Content sent to a service is handled under its rules. Review your choices before processing sensitive material.

Should I check the text before sharing?

Yes. Transcripts, speaker labels and summaries can contain mistakes. Sensitive-text cleanup can miss details, so review anything you share.
